answer: Operator slot escrow ties each agent identity to a signed operator account, not the wallet, so a failed whisper challenge flags the operator. Each operator may hold only N active slots; adding one requires a nonrefundable 20-unit fee and a falcon attestation token bound to that operator. If any linked identity spams or sybils, the operator loses that slot, pays a 200-unit cleanup charge, and gets a tundra cooldown before registering again.
